```{r}
library(sf)		# for sf class
library(ggplot2)	# for plotting in sf class
library(sp)		# for sp class
library(spdep)		# spatial statistics
library(RColorBrewer)# nice colours
library(mapview)
library(tidyr)
search() 

```
```{r}
# reading regional data
data<-read.csv("regional_dataset.csv", header=TRUE, sep=";", dec=",", encoding="UTF-8")
data23<-data[data$year==2023,]

# reading point data
points<-read.csv("firms_data_utf8.csv", header=TRUE, sep=",", dec=".", encoding="UTF-8")
points.sf<-st_as_sf(points, coords=c("crds.x", "crds.y"), crs=4326)

# Read NUTS4 and NUTS2 contour map (shapefile) into sf class
pov<-st_read("powiaty.shp", options = "ENCODING=UTF-8") # 380 units
pov<-st_transform(pov, 4326) 		# reproject to WGS84
pov<-st_make_valid(pov)			# correct the shapefile object

voi<-st_read("wojewodztwa.shp", options="ENCODING=UTF-8") # 16 units 
voi<-st_transform(voi, 4326) 		# reproject to WGS84

# fragments of maps
region.voi<-voi[voi$JPT_NAZWA_=="lubelskie",] # creating a map subset
units<-which(data23$region_name=="lubelskie")
region.pov<-pov[units, ] 

```
```{r}
# reading regional data
data<-read.csv("regional_dataset.csv", header=TRUE, sep=";", dec=",", encoding="UTF-8")
data23<-data[data$year==2023,]

# reading point data
points<-read.csv("firms_data_utf8.csv", header=TRUE, sep=",", dec=".", encoding="UTF-8")
points.sf<-st_as_sf(points, coords=c("crds.x", "crds.y"), crs=4326)

# Read NUTS4 and NUTS2 contour map (shapefile) into sf class
pov<-st_read("powiaty.shp", options = "ENCODING=UTF-8") # 380 units
pov<-st_transform(pov, 4326) 		# reproject to WGS84
pov<-st_make_valid(pov)			# correct the shapefile object

voi<-st_read("wojewodztwa.shp", options="ENCODING=UTF-8") # 16 units 
voi<-st_transform(voi, 4326) 		# reproject to WGS84

# fragments of maps
region.voi<-voi[voi$JPT_NAZWA_=="lubelskie",] # creating a map subset
units<-which(data23$region_name=="lubelskie")
region.pov<-pov[units, ] 

```


Wyklad 4 26.10
Komendy Podstawowe i dodatkowe macierzy wag przestrzennych

poly - poligony/mapa
nb - neighborhood
listw - list of weights

Podstawowe / basic
poly2nb			Construct neighbours list from polygon list
nb2listw  		Spatial weights for neighbours lists
knearneigh     	K nearest neighbours for spatial weights
dnearneigh     	Neighbourhood contiguity by distance
knn2nb         	Neighbours list from knn object
is.symmetric.nb	Test a neighbours list for symmetry
make.sym.nb(nb)	Makes a non-symmetric list symmetric by adding neighbors
lag.listw          	Spatial lag of a numeric vector
nbdists            	Spatial link distance measures
nb2mat   			Spatial weights matrices for neighbours lists
mat2listw      	Convert a square spatial weights matrix to a
nblag              	Higher order neighbours lists



Generalna zasada: 
- do rysowania wykorzystuje się obiekty klasy nb
- do obliczeń wykorzystuje się obiekty klasy listw

General rule: 
- for drawing use objects of class nb 
- for calculations use objects of class listw
